summary: Rabbi Tawil explains the Hashiva Shofetinu berachah of the Amidah, which asks Hashem to restore our judges and advisors. He discusses the distinction between judges and advisors, the importance of Torah-based justice, and the significance of the closing phrase Melech Ohev Tzedakah Umishpat.
questions: What is the difference between a judge and an advisor in the context of the Amidah?
Why is it considered a desecration of Hashem's name to take disputes to secular courts?
Why does the closing of this berachah change during the Aseret Yemei Teshuvah?
What is the significance of the phrase Melech Ohev Tzedakah Umishpat?
